content: 1. Peginterferon alfa-2b reduces glyburide levels by altering hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Close monitoring is required when co-administered with CYP2C9 substrates, as therapeutic effects may be altered. 2. Peginterferon alfa-2b may alter the therapeutic effects of haloperidol by affecting CYP2D6 substrates. Monitor closely and use caution. 3. Peginterferon alfa-2b can increase or decrease levels of CYP2D6 substrates. This may affect the therapeutic efficacy of drugs metabolized by CYP2D6. Monitor closely. 4. Peginterferon alfa-2b reduces ibuprofen levels by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 5. Peginterferon alfa-2b reduces intravenous ibuprofen levels by altering CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Therapeutic effects of CYP2C9 substrates may be altered. Monitor closely. 6. Co-administration of ifosfamide and peginterferon alfa-2b may increase toxicity due to pharmacodynamic synergy. Monitor for enhanced myelosuppression risk. 7. Peginterferon alfa-2b may alter the therapeutic effects of imipramine by affecting CYP2D6 substrates. Monitor closely and use caution. 8. Peginterferon alfa-2b reduces indomethacin levels by altering hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Monitor closely for changes in therapeutic effects. 9. Co-administration of lamivudine and peginterferon alfa-2b may increase toxicity due to pharmacodynamic synergy, with an elevated risk of liver decompensation. Monitor closely. 10. Peginterferon alfa-2b reduces losartan levels by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Monitor closely for altered therapeutic effects. 11. Peginterferon alfa-2b may alter the therapeutic effects of maprotiline by affecting CYP2D6 substrates. Monitor closely and use caution. 12. Peginterferon alfa-2b may increase methadone levels through an unknown mechanism, potentially enhancing narcotic effects and adverse reactions. Monitor for signs of increased narcotic effects and adjust methadone dosage as needed. 13. Peginterferon alfa-2b may alter the therapeutic effects of methamphetamine by affecting CYP2D6 substrates. Peginterferon alfa-2b reduces naproxen levels by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Monitor closely for altered therapeutic effects. 19. Peginterferon alfa-2b reduces nateglinide levels by altering hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Monitor closely for changes in therapeutic effects. 20. Peginterferon alfa-2b may alter the therapeutic effects of nortriptyline by affecting CYP2D6 substrates. Monitor closely and use caution. 21. Peginterferon alfa-2b may alter the therapeutic effects of paroxetine by affecting CYP2D6 substrates. Monitor closely and use caution. 23. Pegloticase may reduce the levels or effects of peginterferon alfa-2b due to potential anti-PEG antibody development. Monitor closely for clinical significance. 24. Pegvaliase-treated patients often develop anti-PEG antibodies, which may pose risks when co-administered with other PEGylated products. Monitor closely and review all drug labels for PEG content. 25. Peginterferon alfa-2b may alter the therapeutic effects of perphenazine by affecting CYP2D6 substrates. Monitor closely and use caution. 26. Co-administration of peginterferon alfa-2b and pexidartinib increases the risk of hepatotoxicity. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 27. Peginterferon alfa-2b reduces phenytoin levels by altering hepatic enzyme CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Monitor closely for changes in therapeutic effects. 28. Co-administration of peginterferon alfa-2b and pretomanid increases toxicity risk, particularly hepatotoxicity. Avoid alcohol and hepatotoxic agents. 29. Peginterferon alfa-2b may alter the therapeutic effects of promethazine by affecting CYP2D6 substrates. Monitor closely and use caution. 30. Peginterferon alfa-2b increases zidovudine levels, potentially enhancing adverse effects such as myelosuppression. Monitor closely for toxicity.
